change: Package staging is removed in a finally boundary. Before promoting a replacement, the existing win-unpacked directory is moved to a unique backup; failed promotion removes partial output and restores the previous app. The staging/promotion helpers are isolated from Electron and NSIS imports.

checks: staging is cleaned after an operation fails while the original error is preserved
simulated Windows EPERM rename then partial ENOSPC copy failure removes partial output and restores old Win-Box.exe

limitations: No fresh package or installer was built after this change.
No clean-directory application launch or JS/JVM/Python, extraction, and download runtime matrix was run.
